topLevel.title: $schema
topLevel.description: Points to the file that describes the theme format. Most themes can leave this out.

topLevel.title: Report theme name
topLevel.description: Sets the name Power BI displays for the imported theme.

topLevel.title: Report base theme name
topLevel.description: Names the built-in Power BI theme that this custom theme builds on.

topLevel.title: Data Colors
topLevel.description: Sets the ordered colour palette used for data series and categories.

topLevel.title: Icons
topLevel.description: Custom icons, each with a name and an image, that conditional formatting in the report can use.

topLevel.title: Foreground
topLevel.description: The main text colour. Power BI uses it for labels, table and matrix values, card values and many other pieces of text. Same as "firstLevelElements".
constraints: Colour code: # followed by 6 characters, such as #1A73E8. Shorter codes (#FFF) and 8-character codes with transparency (#1A73E8CC) also work.

topLevel.title: First Level Elements
topLevel.description: Also called "foreground". Label background (outside data points), trend line colour, textbox default colour, table/matrix values and totals font colour, data bars axis colour, card data labels, gauge callout value, KPI goal and text colour, slicer item/header/dropdown/numeric-input colour, scatter chart ratio line, line chart forecast line, map leader line, filter pane and card text, modern tooltip text and icons.
constraints: Colour code: # followed by 6 characters, such as #1A73E8. Shorter codes (#FFF) and 8-character codes with transparency (#1A73E8CC) also work.

topLevel.title: Second Level Elements
topLevel.description: Also called "foregroundNeutralSecondary". Light secondary text classes, legend/axis label colour, table/matrix header font colour, gauge target and its leader line, KPI trend axis, slicer slider/item font/outline colour, line chart hover colour, multi-row card title, ribbon chart stroke, shape map border, button text/icon/outline colour.
constraints: Colour code: # followed by 6 characters, such as #1A73E8. Shorter codes (#FFF) and 8-character codes with transparency (#1A73E8CC) also work.

topLevel.title: Third Level Elements
topLevel.description: Also called "backgroundLight". Axis gridline colour, table/matrix grid colour, slicer header background in focus mode, multi-row card outline, shape fill colour, gauge arc background, applied filter card background, disabled button fill/outline when the button's own background is white.
constraints: Colour code: # followed by 6 characters, such as #1A73E8. Shorter codes (#FFF) and 8-character codes with transparency (#1A73E8CC) also work.

topLevel.title: Fourth Level Elements
topLevel.description: Also called "foregroundNeutralTertiary". Dimmed legend entries, Card and multi-row card category label colour, multi-row card bar colour, funnel chart conversion-rate stroke, disabled button text/icon colour.
constraints: Colour code: # followed by 6 characters, such as #1A73E8. Shorter codes (#FFF) and 8-character codes with transparency (#1A73E8CC) also work.

topLevel.title: Background
